text_pipeline: clean -> rule replace -> fuzzy -> diacritize -> learned stop-word removal -> BoW + attention -> sentence-transformer

provenance.disclosure: SYNTHETIC DATA - generated by generate_cardiac_dataset.py. These are not real patient records and must not be described as such in any publication, evaluation or deployment.
provenance.label_method: Triage_Level sampled first from LEVEL_MIX; Complaint_Text, ECG_Status and vitals then sampled conditional on it with deliberate overlap between adjacent levels, so no single feature determines the label.
provenance.phrase_bank_source: Fragments derived from the cardiac subset of triage_mixed_language_dataset_10000_RECOVERED.csv (7,855 rows, 887 distinct complaints, 636-word vocabulary). The 22 genuine Level-4 complaints in that file seed the Level-4 branch.
provenance.note: Subset: the 2,252 rows whose Complaint_Text was translated to English before the API ran out of credits. Complaints are the gpt-4o-mini translations; labels and vitals are unchanged.

scope.note: Trained exclusively on cardiac presentations. Predictions for non-cardiac complaints (trauma, burns, neurological, obstetric, etc.) are OUT OF SCOPE and must not be relied on.

experiment: English-translation pipeline, 2,252 rows vs the submitted model 10,000 - TRAINING text translated by gpt-4o-mini; serving now translates locally via Ollama
experiment_caveats: Trained on 2,252 rows because the translation API ran out of credits at 22.5%.
The submitted Roman Urdu model used all 10,000 rows, so accuracy is NOT comparable.
Under-triage 13.08% exceeds the <10% safety band the submitted model holds at 9.25%.
Text bypasses the Roman Urdu dictionary (--skip-normalization).

learned_stopwords.json in the project root now holds ENGLISH stop words; the Roman Urdu list is saved as learned_stopwords_ROMAN_URDU_BACKUP.json and must be restored before running the submitted model.
